title: Short clip: can its time be trusted?
brief: A 49-second phone clip filmed in a dark room is said to have been recorded on Sunday 8 November 2026 at about 11:03 UTC. The time matters to a dispute. The same phone made other recordings that day, which can be requested from the owner if needed.

evidence.label: Phone clip, 49 s, dark room with ceiling strip lights

on_request.label: Another recording from the same phone the same day: 18 min, indoor under ceiling strip lights
